Demo Institute of Health Sciences
Annual Report 2023-24
Sector-18, Demo City

1. ACADEMIC PERFORMANCE
The Institute offered three undergraduate programmes during the
academic year 2023-24. Results were placed before the Academic Council.

2. NAAC ACCREDITATION
The Institute maintained its accreditation status. The Internal
Quality Assurance Cell coordinated the assessment visit documentation.

3. RESEARCH
Research centres continued their funded projects during the year.

4. PLACEMENTS
Students placed: 96
Median salary: INR 420000 per annum
Campus placement drives were conducted with 24 recruiters visiting
the Institute during the year under report.

5. IQAC ACTIVITIES
The Annual Quality Assurance Report was filed with the council.

The accounts of the Institute have been audited and are enclosed.
